sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
You prime all Speed Seals you have marking a creature, and use it to flash between each one at blinding speeds. Make a melee Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu) attack vs the AC of all marked creatures.

On a hit, you deal 5d6 Wind or Lightning damage if a ninjutsu attack or your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage]) + 3d6 if a Taijutsu attack.

Each affected creature must then make a Dexterity saving throw being Concussed on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can select one damaged creature, and teleport into a space that can hold you, that is adjacent to them.
